prompt: Use case: illustration-story / identity-preserving animation key poses. Make a production sprite atlas for an offline children's learning app. Polished friendly storybook animal illustration with soft shaded fur/feathers/scales, clear anatomy and expressive eyes, matching the reference style. ONE animal identity reused in ALL cells, camera/head size/body proportions/markings EXACTLY consistent. Every pose is full body, no cropped limbs. All face RIGHT unless subject says front-facing. Genuine transparent background, NO coloured paper/background, floor, panels, labels, letters, numbers, arrows, speech bubbles, motion lines, cast shadows or decorative objects. Equal square grid cells with 8% safe margins, consistent scale, same notional ground baseline 85% down each cell for grounded poses. The top LEFT cell is frame1 and order is row-major. Carefully articulate actual jaws/legs/wings/tails; do NOT simply rotate/scale the entire animal as a substitute.  Layout: 4 columns, 2 rows, 8 poses. Each cell SQUARE. Overall atlas aspect ratio 4:2; exactly one full animal per cell with safe margins. Empty spaces ALPHA ZERO, no white/grey page or grid. Input reference STYLE ONLY, not rabbit anatomy or colours. A friendly full-body golden lion with warm brown mane, cream muzzle and tail tuft. EIGHT ROAR poses: standing alert closed mouth, inhale/chest set, lift chin, open jaw, much wider jaw and visible pink mouth with rounded teeth, sustained exhale/focussed brows, mouth closing, relaxed recovery. Body and planted paws same outline/position/scale throughout; change jaw, eyes and head posture. No threatening aggression.
